Scholarship Name: Don Mariano F. Jhocson Gold Scholar
Year Level restrictions: Incoming first-year college students (graduating Senior High School)
Required Documents: Complete basic Admissions Requirements
Certificate of Overall Academic Recognition signed by the principal indicating the academic award received

Proof of Family Income: Certificate of Indigency from the barangay (for parents without source of income), OR Latest Tax Exemption Certificate or Income Tax Return (ITR) for both parents showing a combined annual income of Php360,000 or less
Two (2) recommendation letters from your current school administrators or teachers, addressed to the NU Campus Head, Dr. Arlene O. Trillanes, and the Admissions Office
Photocopy of a valid ID from each of the recommenders with their affixed signatures
